subject: Welcome to your apprenticeship, {{first_name}}
body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Welcome to {{standard_title}} with {{employer_name}}. You start on {{start_date}} and your planned end date is {{planned_end_date}}.

A few things worth knowing on day one:

  Your tutor is {{tutor_name}} — they are your first point of contact for anything.
  You are an employee first. Your contract and pay come from {{employer_name}}; we handle the training.
  At least {{otj_hours_target}} hours of your apprenticeship are off-the-job training. Log them as you go rather than trying to reconstruct them later — this is the single thing apprentices most often leave until it is a problem.

You will have a progress review with us and your employer roughly every {{review_frequency}}.

Any questions before you start, just reply.

{{tutor_name}}
{{provider_name}}
